source_title: 2026 Korea Seafarer's Statistical Year Book — Leisure & Ferry Boat (Coastal Ships)
publisher: Korea Seafarers Welfare & Employment Center / Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries statistical publication

model_check.manning_pattern: one master plus one deck rating per operating crew
model_check.decision: Retain the live workbook crew cost. The difference is immaterial and may reflect source/FX rounding. Do not reduce headcount without Korean safe-manning validation.

limitations: The wage table supports pay levels, not the vessel's required safe-manning certificate.
The 1.8 relief-team and 1.2 payroll-burden multipliers remain model assumptions and must stay visible.
No unsupported crew reduction is used in the payback scenario.
